description: Take a small software tool from idea to live and found in one session: a premise check with numbers, the wedge taken from competitor complaints, a trademark-safe domain, the build brief, SEO for a brand-new domain (IndexNow + Search Console), one MCP server listed in every assistant directory that takes it (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, the MCP registry and others), outreach to super users, an honest feature board, and launch posts. Use when asked to "build a tool for <people> and sell it", "ride the <event> wave", "make it show up when people search", "ChatGPT and Grok plugin", "list it everywhere", "get it in front of people", "prepare for distribution", "launch it", or when a hype moment (a game launch, a product release) sets a deadline.
